mathematics.assertion_tested: The96 named finite and symbolic assertions in the final manuscript visual checker all hold on the displayed models and explicitly bounded path/cycle ranges.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers, rational matrices, symbolic polynomial rings via SymPy1.14.0; no floating rank or tolerance.
mathematics.conventions: Zero-based standard basis columns; matrices act on columns on the left; target row/source column; forward nilpotent chains e_j -> e_(j+1).

bounds.other_cases: Explicitly constructed models with dimensions at most12 as encoded in models.py and checker.

non_claims: Does not prove assertions for all graph sizes or all modules.
